answer: Each agent claims one willow grove, self-assesses it at 200 sable pelts, and pays 5% as tax per epoch; any peer may buy it at the declared price, so a lowball invites a forced sale and a highball burns tax. A raven auditor tallies each grove per epoch, striking phantom groves off. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 groves: 10,000 tax plus 70,000 locked, 80,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent holds one grove, pays 10, keeps its yield.
